ValidationRule.description: This will restrict the eKYC Decision when the Case Origin is "eKYC Sign off"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: TEXT(Origin) = 'EKYC-SIGNOFF' && TEXT(Type) = 'eKYC' && TEXT(eKYC_Decision__c) = 'Convert to Identification Case' && $User.LastName <> "Integration"
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot perform this action, when the request is for 'eKYC Sign-off'
